title: Nominalization
goal: Turn verbs and adjectives into nouns (augmenter → l'augmentation) to write concise headlines, notes and formal sentences, and predict the gender of the noun from its suffix.

items.en: nominalization: turning a verb or adjective into a noun

drills.en: Rents are going up → the increase in rents
drills.explain: [[augmenter]] → [[l'augmentation]] (-tion, feminine). The subject becomes a complement with [[de]]: [[des loyers]].

drills.text: On a fermé l'usine → ___ fermeture de l'usine
drills.en: They closed the factory → the closing of the factory
drills.explain: Nouns in -ure are feminine: [[la fermeture]], [[la signature]], [[l'ouverture]].

drills.prompt: Which nominalization of “Après avoir vérifié les documents, …” is correct?
drills.explain: [[vérifier]] → [[la vérification]]. In formal French, [[après vérification]] (no article) is a fixed, concise pattern.

drills.en: The refund will be made in May.
drills.explain: Nouns in -ment are masculine: [[le remboursement]], [[le changement]], [[le développement]].

drills.text: ___ fiabilité de ce logiciel est excellente.
drills.explain: Nouns in -ité are feminine: [[la fiabilité]], [[la sécurité]], [[la rapidité]].
Most nouns in -age are masculine, except a few short ones: [[la page]], [[la plage]], [[l'image]], [[la cage]], [[la nage]], [[la rage]].

example.fr: L'augmentation des prix inquiète les familles.
example.en: The increase in prices worries families.

example.fr: On observe une baisse de 3 % du chômage.
example.en: We're seeing a 3 percent drop in unemployment.

items.note: No suffix at all: [[baisser]] → [[la baisse]]. Same with [[hausser]] → [[la hausse]].

example.fr: Hausse des tarifs de transport en commun
la mise en place d'un nouveau système
example.en: the setting up of a new system

items.note: The noun of [[mettre]] is [[la mise]]: [[la mise à jour]] (update), [[la mise en ligne]] (posting online).
Abstract nouns in -eur are feminine: [[la lenteur]], [[la chaleur]], [[la longueur]]. But people in -eur are masculine: [[le chercheur]].

steps.title: From sentences to headlines
steps.intro: Headlines, slides, meeting notes and formal reports all use the same trick: they **turn verbs into nouns**. Read these headlines from a local news site, then see how Raj turns his messy notes into a clean slide.

blocks.title: Info Région : les titres du jour
blocks.context: Fictional headlines from an imaginary regional news site (the facts and figures are invented).
blocks.fr:
Hausse de 4 % des tarifs de transport en commun dès le 1er juillet
Fermeture temporaire du pont Champlain : les automobilistes invités à prévoir un détour
Déneigement : la Ville promet une amélioration du service cet hiver
Recrutement d'infirmières : ouverture d'une clinique de reconnaissance des diplômes
Baisse du chômage chez les nouveaux arrivants pour la troisième année consécutive
blocks.en:
Public transit fares up 4 percent from July 1
Temporary closure of the Champlain Bridge: drivers asked to plan a detour
Snow removal: the city promises better service this winter
Nurse recruitment: a clinic for credential recognition opens
Unemployment among newcomers falls for the third year in a row

blocks.title: Raj's notes, before and after
blocks.context: Raj, project coordinator, prepares a slide for Monday's meeting.
blocks.fr:
Avant (notes rapides) :
On va changer de logiciel parce que l'ancien plante tout le temps et il est trop lent. On va former les employés en septembre. Après, on va vérifier si tout fonctionne. Les clients seront remboursés s'il y a eu des erreurs.

Après (diapositive) :
Changement de logiciel
- Motifs : manque de fiabilité et lenteur de l'ancien système
- Formation des employés en septembre
- Vérification du fonctionnement après la mise en place
- Remboursement des clients en cas d'erreur
blocks.en:
Before (quick notes):
We're going to change software because the old one crashes all the time and it's too slow. We're going to train the employees in September. Afterwards, we'll check if everything works. Customers will be refunded if there were errors.

After (slide):
Software change
- Reasons: lack of reliability and slowness of the old system
- Staff training in September
- Check that everything works after implementation
- Customer refunds in case of error

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is the full version of the headline “Fermeture temporaire du pont Champlain”?
options: Le pont Champlain est fermé temporairement.
On construit un nouveau pont Champlain.
blocks.explain: [[la fermeture]] is the noun of [[fermer]]. The adjective [[temporaire]] becomes the adverb [[temporairement]] in the full sentence.

blocks.prompt: In Raj's slide, what became of “il est trop lent”?
blocks.explain: The adjective [[lent]] gives the noun [[la lenteur]] (feminine, like [[la chaleur]], [[la longueur]]).

blocks.title: What nominalization does
blocks.body:
**Nominalization** means replacing a verb (or an adjective) with the matching noun. The sentence gets shorter, more abstract and more formal:

- [[Les loyers ont augmenté de 5 %.]] → [[une augmentation de 5 % des loyers]]
- [[Quand le contrat sera signé, …]] → [[Dès la signature du contrat, …]]
- [[parce que le service est lent]] → [[en raison de la lenteur du service]]

Three things change:
- The **verb becomes a noun** with an article.
- The **subject or object becomes a complement** with [[de]]: [[on ferme l'usine]] → [[la fermeture **de** l'usine]].
- **Adverbs become adjectives**: [[fermer temporairement]] → [[une fermeture temporaire]].

blocks.title: Suffixes and gender
head: Suffix
Gender
Verb or adjective → noun
Watch out
rows: augmenter → l'augmentation, décider → la décision, inscrire → l'inscription
changer → le changement, rembourser → le remboursement, déneiger → le déneigement
nettoyer → le nettoyage, laver → le lavage, partager → le partage
except la page, la plage, l'image, la cage, la nage
fermer → la fermeture, ouvrir → l'ouverture, signer → la signature
fiable → la fiabilité, rapide → la rapidité, simple → la simplicité
except le comité, le traité, l'été
croître → la croissance, préférer → la préférence
lent → la lenteur, chaud → la chaleur, long → la longueur
but le bonheur, le malheur, l'honneur
baisser → la baisse, hausser → la hausse, refuser → le refus, retourner → le retour, choisir → le choix
blocks.note: The suffix rule is reliable enough to guess in an exam. When you learn a new noun, always learn it with its article.

blocks.title: Common formal patterns
blocks.pattern: préposition + nom (sans article) / nom + de + complément
blocks.note: Some prepositions take the noun directly, without an article. These are very frequent in official letters and instructions.

examples.fr: Après vérification, votre dossier est complet.
examples.en: After checking, your file is complete.

examples.fr: En cas de retard, prévenez la réception.
examples.en: In case of delay, notify reception.

examples.fr: Dès réception du paiement, nous enverrons la commande.
examples.en: As soon as payment is received, we'll ship the order.

examples.fr: En raison des travaux, la station est fermée.
examples.en: Due to construction, the station is closed.

blocks.title: Gender slips and heavy sentences
blocks.body:
- **[[la changement]]** ✗ → [[le changement]] ✓. Trust the suffix: -ment is masculine.
- **[[le décision]]**, **[[le solution]]** ✗ → [[la décision]], [[la solution]] ✓. Every noun in -tion/-sion is feminine.
- **Inventing a noun**: [[la vérifiement]] ✗, [[le recrutation]] ✗. The verb chooses its suffix: [[vérifier → la vérification]], [[recruter → le recrutement]]. When in doubt, check.
- **Forgetting [[de]]**: [[l'augmentation les prix]] ✗ → [[l'augmentation **des** prix]] ✓
- **Too many nouns in a row**: [[la mise en place de la vérification de la conformité des demandes]] is correct but unreadable. In emails and speech, go back to a verb: [[nous vérifierons si les demandes sont conformes]].
- **Mixing styles in a list**: a slide with [[Formation des employés]] then [[On va vérifier]] looks careless. Keep all bullets in the same form (all nouns, or all infinitives).

blocks.title: Why does French love nouns?
blocks.body: English formal writing often prefers verbs (“after we check the file…”). French administrative and journalistic writing has a strong tradition of **noun style** ([[style nominal]]): it's compact and sounds objective, because it hides who does the action. [[Fermeture du pont]] doesn't say who closes it. That's why headlines, forms and official letters are full of nouns, and why recognizing them quickly is a big help in TEF and TCF reading.

blocks.title: Nouns you'll see everywhere in Canada
blocks.body:
- **[[le déneigement]]** (snow removal) and **[[le stationnement]]** (parking) appear on every street sign in Québec winters: [[Stationnement interdit – déneigement]].
- **[[l'inscription]]** (registration), **[[le renouvellement]]** (renewal) and **[[la demande]]** (application) are the key nouns on government websites: [[renouvellement du permis de conduire]], [[demande de résidence permanente]].
- **[[l'embauche]]** (hiring) is very common in Québec job ads: [[Embauche immédiate !]]
- **[[la francisation]]** (French-language training for newcomers) is the noun of [[franciser]].

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Headlines are read with a falling tone and no verb. Make the [[de]] link clear.

lines.fr: Hausse des tarifs de transport en commun.
lines.tip: The h of [[hausse]] is aspirated: [[la hausse]], no liaison, no elision.

lines.fr: Après vérification, votre dossier est complet.
lines.en: After checking, your file is complete.

lines.fr: En raison des travaux, la station est fermée.
lines.en: Due to construction, the station is closed.

lines.fr: La mise en place du nouveau système aura lieu en septembre.
lines.en: The new system will be set up in September.

blocks.fr: En raison de la tempête, la Ville annonce la fermeture de toutes les écoles et le report de la collecte des ordures à jeudi.
blocks.en: Because of the storm, the city announces the closure of all schools and the postponement of garbage collection to Thursday.
blocks.explain: [[le report]] is the noun of [[reporter]] (to postpone): [[le report de la collecte à jeudi]].

blocks.fr: La direction confirme l'ouverture d'une deuxième clinique à Sherbrooke et le recrutement de quarante infirmières d'ici l'automne.
blocks.en: Management confirms the opening of a second clinic in Sherbrooke and the hiring of forty nurses by the fall.
options: A new clinic will open and forty nurses will be hired
A clinic will close and forty nurses will leave
Forty clinics will open in the fall
blocks.explain: [[l'ouverture]] (opening) and [[le recrutement]] (hiring) are the nouns of [[ouvrir]] and [[recruter]].

blocks.fr: Le remboursement sera effectué dès réception de votre demande.
blocks.explain: [[dès réception de]]: formal pattern with no article. [[Le remboursement]]: masculine (-ment).

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Some questions bring back reformulation and precise formal formulas from Unit 05.

blocks.text: On a annulé le vol → ___ du vol
blocks.en: They cancelled the flight → the cancellation of the flight

blocks.prompt: Choose the correct article: “___ nettoyage des bureaux a lieu le vendredi.”
Match each verb or adjective with its noun.

accept: La hausse des loyers à Montréal
blocks.hint: No verb: start with a noun.
blocks.explain: Headlines drop the verb and often the article: [[Hausse des loyers à Montréal]].

blocks.text: ___ cas de retard, prévenez la réception. ___ réception du paiement, nous enverrons la commande.
blocks.en: In case of delay, notify reception. As soon as payment is received, we'll send the order.
blocks.explain: Fixed formal patterns with no article: [[en cas de]], [[dès réception de]].
The noun [[fermeture]] takes the adjective [[temporaire]], not the adverb [[temporairement]].

blocks.prompt: Due to the slowness of the service, we are changing suppliers.
accept: En raison de la lenteur du service, nous changeons de fournisseur.
En raison de la lenteur du service, on change de fournisseur.
À cause de la lenteur du service, nous changeons de fournisseur.
À cause de la lenteur du service, on change de fournisseur.
En raison de la lenteur du service, nous changeons de fournisseurs.
En raison de la lenteur du service, nous allons changer de fournisseur.
Vu la lenteur du service, nous changeons de fournisseur.
blocks.explain: [[lent]] → [[la lenteur]]; [[en raison de]] is the formal choice. Note [[changer **de** fournisseur]], singular.

blocks.text: Le projet coûtera 50 000 $, ___ une ___ de 10 % par rapport à l'an dernier.
blocks.en: The project will cost 50,000 dollars, that is, a 10 percent increase compared to last year.
blocks.explain: [[soit]] gives the equivalent (lesson 1); after [[une]], you need the noun [[augmentation]] or [[hausse]].

blocks.fr: La mise en place du nouveau logiciel est prévue pour septembre.
blocks.explain: [[la mise en place]] = setting up. [[prévue]] agrees with [[la mise]] (feminine).

blocks.prompt: Which slide bullet list is consistent?
options: Formation des employés / Vérification des accès / Mise à jour du site
Formation des employés / On vérifie les accès / Mettre à jour le site
Former les employés / Vérification des accès / On met à jour le site
blocks.explain: All three bullets use the same form (noun + [[de]] + complement). Mixing forms looks careless.

blocks.prompt: Your team has decided several changes (a new schedule, new software, a training session, a move, new hires…). First write 4–5 slide bullets using only nouns. Then write a short paragraph for an email that explains the same changes with full sentences.
blocks.promptFr: Rédigez une diapositive (style nominal) puis un paragraphe de courriel.
checklist: At least one -tion, one -ment and one -ure noun with the right article
One formal pattern: en raison de / dès / en cas de / après
A paragraph that turns the nouns back into verbs

models.label: Model answer
models.fr:
Réorganisation du service client
- Ouverture d'un deuxième bureau à Laval en janvier
- Recrutement de trois conseillers bilingues
- Formation de l'équipe au nouveau logiciel
- Fermeture du bureau le vendredi après-midi

Bonjour à tous,
Dès janvier, nous ouvrirons un deuxième bureau à Laval et nous recruterons trois conseillers bilingues. Toute l'équipe sera formée au nouveau logiciel. En raison de cette formation, le bureau sera fermé le vendredi après-midi pendant un mois.
models.en:
Reorganization of customer service
- Opening of a second office in Laval in January
- Hiring of three bilingual advisors
- Team training on the new software
- Office closed on Friday afternoons

Hello everyone,
From January, we'll open a second office in Laval and hire three bilingual advisors. The whole team will be trained on the new software. Because of this training, the office will be closed on Friday afternoons for a month.

blocks.prompt: Read three headlines you invent about your city (one rise, one closure, one opening). Then explain each one in a full sentence, as a radio host would.
checklist: Three headlines with nouns: hausse / fermeture / ouverture…
Each headline turned into a full sentence with a verb

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Premier titre : Hausse du prix des billets de métro. Autrement dit, à partir de juillet, le billet coûtera 25 cents de plus. Deuxième titre : Fermeture de la piscine municipale pour rénovation. La piscine fermera ses portes tout l'été. Troisième titre : Ouverture d'un centre d'accueil pour les nouveaux arrivants. Un nouveau centre ouvrira en septembre, c'est-à-dire juste à temps pour la rentrée.
models.en: First headline: Metro ticket price goes up. In other words, starting in July, the ticket will cost 25 cents more. Second headline: Municipal pool closes for renovation. The pool will close its doors all summer. Third headline: A welcome centre for newcomers opens. A new centre will open in September, that is, just in time for back-to-school.

summary:
- Turn a verb into a noun: [[augmenter → l'augmentation]], [[fermer → la fermeture]], [[rembourser → le remboursement]]
- Predict gender: -tion, -ure, -ité, -ance are feminine; -ment and -age are masculine (with a few exceptions)
- Write concise headlines and slides, and use formal patterns: [[après vérification]], [[dès réception de]], [[en raison de]]
- Know when to switch back to verbs so your text stays readable
